maria_cs: Ping — BlueHarbor submitted a bespoke security questionnaire and opened a support ticket (#BH-12345). They reported: API 401s this morning, latency spikes, and an unexpected billing increase. Customer asks for: (1) audit log sample for last 30 days, (2) KMS/HSM rotation evidence and attestation, (3) incident timeline and repro steps. They want a deliverable by EOD Friday. Can SRE + Security + Billing triage? :pray:

sam_sre: On it. I looked at our traces — the 401s line up with an expired service key on their dedicated pool. Repro steps from the curl they sent:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}'
```
We rotated their token at 08:42 UTC; after rotation requests returned 200. Latency spike correlates with autoscaler churn between 08:35-08:50. I'll pull audit snippets and request full CSV export (redacted) for CS.

eli_security: For the questionnaire we can provide: rotation timestamps, KMS key metadata, signed HSM attestation (certificate chain), and a short custody/ops note. Legal needs to review attestation wording before we hand it to the customer. Also note: default audit retention = 90 days; BlueHarbor asked for 3 years — we need a signed exception or export.

kevin_billing: Billing spike looks like retry storms while their client got 401s. We can estimate amount from request_id ranges. Propose a one-time goodwill credit while we investigate.

sam_sre: Quick audit snippet (redacted):
```
2026-03-12T08:41:32Z - API_KEY=redacted - client=blueharbor - route=/v1/generate - status=401 - reason=invalid_token
2026-03-12T08:42:15Z - API_KEY=redacted - client=blueharbor - route=/v1/generate - status=200 - latency_ms=120
```
I will export the full CSV for last 30 days and scrub IPs/token ids before sharing. Will publish secure link to CS.

maria_cs: Thanks Sam. Eli — can you confirm exactly which artifacts will be included in the attestation bundle? Customer expects an envelope they can attach to the bespoke questionnaire.

eli_security: We'll include:
- Rotation schedule table (UTC timestamps)
- KMS key IDs and versions (redacted IDs)
- HSM firmware/version and signed cert chain (no private material)
- Short paragraph on key custody & access controls
- Snapshot of current retention configuration (policy link + JSON export)
We will NOT include any private keys or unredacted credentials. Drafting now; will route to legal for review.

kevin_billing: Proposed credit: $1,200 one-time goodwill. Approve?

maria_cs: Approved. I'll raise the credit ticket and patch the invoice.

sam_sre: Upload (redacted) link for audit CSV: https://redwood-files/secure/blueharbor-audit-1769998888.csv (expires in 72h). Shared via CS secure channel.

maria_cs: Customer deadline is Fri COB (2026-03-13). Tagging @eli_security and @sam_sre — please prioritize. :calendar:

eli_security: Acknowledged. Draft attestation by Thu EOD. Legal review required; cc-ing legal for turnaround.

audit-bot: Document created: BH-SIG-1769998888-draft (access restricted).

maria_cs: Thanks team — I'll update BlueHarbor with timeline, attach the secure link, and confirm the credit. Will follow up with the bespoke questionnaire bundle when legal signs off.
